transactions.desc: The Red Sox recalled Burgos from Triple-A Worcester on Wednesday, Chris Cotillo of MassLive.com reports.
The Red Sox optioned Paez to Triple-A Worcester on Wednesday, Chris Cotillo of MassLive.com reports.
The Nationals designated Cosgrove for assignment Wednesday.
The Nationals recalled Cornelio from Triple-A Rochester on Wednesday.
The Nationals activated Wood (oblique) from the 10-day injured list Wednesday.
Atlanta designated Harris for assignment Wednesday.
Atlanta selected Hernandez's contract from Triple-A Gwinnett on Wednesday.
Atlanta optioned Burkhalter to Triple-A Gwinnett on Wednesday.
The Orioles designated Raquet for assignment Tuesday.
The Orioles designated Weston for assignment Tuesday.
The Nationals optioned Pinckney to Triple-A Rochester on Tuesday.
The Tigers recalled Brieske from Triple-A Toledo on Tuesday.
The Giants have Ramos on the taxi squad Tuesday, Justice delos Santos of The San Jose Mercury News reports.
The Giants recalled Morgan from Triple-A Sacramento on Tuesday, Justice delos Santos of The San Jose Mercury News reports.
The Diamondbacks reinstated Gurriel (thigh) from the 10-day injured list Tuesday.
The Diamondbacks reinstated Walston (elbow) from the 60-day injured list Tuesday.
Topa signed a minor-league contract with the Yankees on Tuesday, Gary Phillips of the New York Daily News reports.
The Angels recalled Paris from Triple-A Salt Lake on Tuesday.
The Orioles selected Suarez's contract from Triple-A Norfolk on Tuesday.
The Angels reinstated Natera (back) from the 15-day injured list Tuesday.
The Blue Jays recalled Keys from Triple-A Buffalo on Tuesday.
The Rockies recalled Castano from Triple-A Albuquerque on Tuesday.
The Rockies recalled Amador from Triple-A Albuquerque on Tuesday.
The Astros recalled Meyers from Triple-A Sugar Land on Tuesday, Brian McTaggart of MLB.com reports.
The Yankees activated McMahon (thumb) from the 10-day injured list Tuesday.
The Tigers activated Greene (hamstring) from the 10-day injured list, and he's starting in left field and batting cleanup Tuesday against the Twins.
The Cubs selected Murray's contract from Triple-A Iowa on Tuesday.
The Cubs recalled Ferguson from Triple-A Iowa on Tuesday.
The Brewers activated Romero (appendectomy) from the 15-day injured list Tuesday.
The Astros recalled Blanco from Triple-A Sugar Land to start Tuesday's game against the White Sox, Brian McTaggart of MLB.com reports.
